verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say it can send and receive money over wires and real-time payments, on a unified infrastructure reachable through its APIs, and claim direct Federal Reserve connectivity. FedNow is never named explicitly, and there is no per-rail capability documentation, only marketing-level summaries with no API reference reachable in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit FedNow and RTP naming with origination/receipt detail, per-rail capability documentation (limits, cutoffs, settlement times), API reference evidence for wire/instant-payment endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the faster rails are there when I need them — domestic wires, RTP, and FedNow origination and receipt through the same API, with per-rail capabilities documented

citations.quote: Send and receive money using payment capabilities including ACH, wires, real-time payments, checks, and international payments, with settlement-level transaction visibility.
Unit is a registered Federal Reserve service provider with direct connectivity to Federal Reserve systems on behalf of partner banks.
They run on a unified infrastructure and native ledger, so companies can combine capabilities without stitching together
